noun_definition: iou-in workspace refers to the specific environment within the app where users can manage and split bills among members of a selected workspace.
Bill detail page refers to the interface within the app where users can view and manage the details of a split bill, including the option to select a category for the transaction.
Category option refers to the selection feature that allows users to choose a specific category for a split bill on the split detail page within the Workspace in the app.
